outlets.quirks: ACCESS: lesoir.be and sudinfo.be are behind Akamai. curl with the prescribed Chrome UA gets 403 "Access Denied" on every path (feeds, robots.txt), but Node 24 native fetch with the same UA header gets 200. All Rossel fixtures were therefore fetched with Node fetch (the production client); no UA rotation or proxies were used. Re-verify from the production server IP, since Akamai may also treat datacenter IPs differently. FORMAT: /rss2//cible_principale (official /rss//... links 301 here). Each feed holds only the latest 10 items. Channel title is always "Actualité - Le Soir" (use our own stream name); xml:base carries "?status=1"; ttl 3. ITEM: CDATA = the article's main tag (not the feed section); link https://www.lesoir.be//article// (dedupe across feeds by nid); description = full plain-text standfirst; pubDate offset is correct (+0200 before 25 Oct, +0100 after, matches JSON-LD). Author appears twice, in a bogus element and in , wrapped in literal double quotes ("\"Louis Colart\"") so strip the quotes; it is missing on Cartes blanches/Kroll and some agency items. guid "https%3A//www.lesoir.be/rossel_extref/Cue- at www.lesoir.be" (isPermaLink=false). IMAGE: media:content@url (dpistyles_v2/ena_16_9_extra_big, ~1-2 MB, has type/fileSize) with nested media:thumbnail@url (ena_16_9_medium) on leseng.rosselcdn.net. The itok token is bound to the style, so use the URLs as given and do not rewrite the style name. PREMIUM: not flagged in the feed, and paywalled articles are mixed in (2 of 5 sampled). It is detectable only on the article page: with icon r-icon--abonne and text "Article réservé aux abonnés", or dataLayer "RestrictedAccess":"Oui" (vs "Non"; also "path":"node//paywall"). JSON-LD isAccessibleForFree is "FALSE" on every article, so it is unreliable. /rss.xml (stream "dernieres"): legacy Drupal feed, channel "Le Soir", latest 10 items chronologically, full article HTML in description with , no media tags, http:// links, pubDate +0000, plus dc:creator/guid/comments. Use only title/link/first image. Soirmag uses /rss2/31920/maga_cible_principale_gratuit. Also verified working (10 items, fresh, same pattern): Société 31868, Enseignement 81610, France 31875, Union européenne 31876, Football belge 42367, Football international 42368, Diables rouges 31883, Cyclisme 31886, Basket 31887, Sports moteurs 31885, Athlétisme 42347, Éditos 22, Cartes blanches 20, Chroniques 21, Sciences et santé 23 (107h), Cinéma 31892 (107h), Musiques 31893, Livres 31894, Scènes 31896, Arts plastiques 31897, Médias 31895. No per-municipality feeds; regional coverage is 4 province feeds plus Bruxelles. outlets.quirks: Arc XP outboundfeeds. Pattern https://www.lavenir.net/arc/outboundfeeds/rss/section/<section path>/?outputType=xml (root: /arc/outboundfeeds/rss/?outputType=xml). Unknown section paths return HTTP 200 with an empty channel, so validate by item count, not status. Window: last 100 items or about 3 weeks. PREMIUM: every item has <dcterms:accessRights> FREE | PAYING (subscriber-only; page shows "Article réservé aux abonnés") | MEMBER (free-registration wall, "Article abonné offert"). Across all IPM feeds fetched: FREE 4128, PAYING 4487, MEMBER 651. pubDate is always labelled +0100 (also in summer time) but the instant matches the article JSON-LD, so parse normally. description is a plain teaser ending in " ..." (strip it). One <category> = section display name. guid = Arc story ID (stable, isPermaLink=false): dedupe across section feeds with it. IMAGE: enclosure@url (type image/jpeg; not media:content, no caption/credit) -> /resizer/v2/<ID>.jpg?auth=<hash>&smart=true&width=1200&height=800; width/height can be changed freely while keeping auth (a bad auth gives 403). Items titled "... - Clone" are CMS duplicates: drop them. ttl 1, cache-control private max-age~81: poll every few minutes at most. No content:encoded. "- Clone" items were seen in regions and regions/mons-centre. Region feeds overlap heavily with each other and with root; dedupe by guid. MUNICIPALITIES: tag-based commune feeds at https://www.lavenir.net/arc/outboundfeeds/rss/section/regions/<region>/<commune>/?outputType=xml, where commune slugs are the links on each region page (https://www.lavenir.net/regions/<region>/).
